constraints.text: Execution, state, composition, policy and binding are open factory choices.

The proposed memory pass/fail budget is 80 GB, decimal, in mem0. Its proposed accounting boundary includes everything the engine container holds in the unified pool at any moment: CPU and GPU process allocations and page cache attributable to files it reads. The operating system and other processes are outside this boundary. The budget choice, unit basis and accounting boundary require confirmation.

The proposed quality baseline is the published reference implementation with NVFP4 weights, the published tokenizer and greedy sampling. The proposed comparison requires the same output tokens as that baseline if no computational change is allowed; otherwise it requires a task score not below a threshold. The task set, threshold and allowed transformations remain UNSET.

in_scope.text: The engine interface accepts text and produces text.

Proposed reporting quantities are time to first token, decode rate and peak memory. Proposed time to first token runs from request admission to production of the first output token and excludes model loading; proposed decode rate excludes the first token; proposed peak memory uses the memory-budget accounting boundary. Their workloads remain UNSET.

desired_change.text: Build a custom inference engine for Meta Muse Spark Open that runs on NVIDIA DGX Spark.

requested_result.text: Deliver the engine as a reproducible container, with a clean rebuild, benchmark report and replayable run artifacts.

out_of_scope.text: Non-text input and output are outside the specified text-input, text-output interface.

user_targets.target_text: Proposed pass/fail budget: 80 GB decimal in unified pool mem0, subject to confirmation of the budget and its accounting boundary.
A pass/fail offered context length in tokens is required but remains UNSET. The model's stated 1,000,000-token allowance does not specify the engine's offered context.
Proposed pass/fail comparison: baseline-identical output tokens if computational changes are disallowed; otherwise a task score at or above an UNSET threshold on an UNSET held-out task set.
